orientation_and_star_conventions.direction_code: Numerical column10 code1 means right-to-left. Both text rows end in1.
orientation_and_star_conventions.reference_surface: Source note4 says right/left refer to impressions for seals and originals for other inscribed objects.
orientation_and_star_conventions.star: Section8 identifies a top-right prefixed asterisk as a sign read doubtfully. The dot-like printed star at the top right of the leftmost2427 glyph agrees with exported *402.
implications: Retain uncertainty for402; matching the drawn form does not resolve the excavated sign.
The star is not an extra sign, lost-passage marker, value marker or phonetic annotation.
Do not silently strip the star and call this a fully certain eight-sign reading.
orientation_and_star_conventions.unknown_span: The same source Codes page section 8 identifies hatching as an illegible or lost passage with one or more signs. This authenticates 000 as an unknown span in 1001 without fixing span length.
